name: Origin Protocol
description: Earth cools, oceans stabilize, and chemistry begins testing life-like loops.
educationalFacts: Early Earth formed about 4.5 billion years ago.
Liquid water made complex chemistry more likely.

name: Biosphere Expansion
description: Photosynthesis, oxygen, and multicellular ecosystems rewrite the planet.
educationalFacts: Oxygen was toxic to many early microbes.
Biodiversity improves resilience.

name: Human Emergence
description: Tool use, fire, language, and migration bring culture into the model.
educationalFacts: Fire changed diets and social organization.
Language accelerated shared learning.

name: Civilization Kernel
description: Farming, cities, writing, and law create durable institutions.
educationalFacts: Agriculture enabled larger settlements.
Writing stabilized records and taxes.

name: Empire Network
description: Trade, roads, bureaucracy, and conflict connect distant regions.
educationalFacts: Trade spreads ideas and diseases.
Shared laws can increase trust.

name: Scientific Awakening
description: Observation, printing, astronomy, and experiments accelerate knowledge.
educationalFacts: Printing made knowledge cheaper to copy.
Experimentation reduces superstition in models.

name: Industrial Engine
description: Steam, factories, electricity, and pollution raise output and risk.
educationalFacts: Fossil fuels concentrated energy for machines.
Industrialization increased urban health challenges.

name: Digital Layer
description: Networks, antibiotics, software, and platform trust reshape civilization.
educationalFacts: Antibiotics changed survival rates.
Digital networks amplify truth and falsehood.

name: Quantum Threshold
description: Quantum processors and planetary simulations strain coherence.
educationalFacts: Quantum systems are sensitive to noise.
Alignment asks whether powerful systems follow human intent.

name: DEVS Protocol
description: The operator faces the final ethics, balance, and responsibility test.
educationalFacts: Power without auditing is fragile.
The stylized V points from operators toward responsibility.

name: DEUS Kernel
description: A symbolic balanced kernel state: mastery through restraint and care.
educationalFacts: Stable systems preserve plurality, memory, and limits.
